name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Concrete.reduction_budget
title: Concrete hybrid budget with reduction overhead: 2^P adv^2 <= L^2 (1+T) c
statement: Let L, P be natural numbers, eps : N -> R, and adv, c, T real with 1 <= c, 0 <= T, 0 <= adv, adv <= sum_{i<L} eps i, and 2^P * (eps i)^2 <= c + T for every i < L. Then 2^P * adv^2 <= L^2 * (1 + T) * c. Reading: if each of L hops is proven by a reduction of additive running-time overhead T to a premise with cost/gain >= 2^P, a cost-c adversary with advantage adv has c/adv^2 >= 2^P / (L^2 (1+T)); reductions may spend up to 2^(P - 128 - 2 log L) steps while keeping 128-bit security. Used in note pq-we-new-directions.
